text: Where is my order? It was supposed to arrive yesterday.
Your tracking link shows the latest shipment status. Please check the tracking details.
I was charged twice for the same order.
We can help review duplicate charges. Please provide the order details through the support channel.
I cannot log into my account.
Please use the account recovery flow. If that does not work, contact support for account-specific help.
Can I get a refund for this order?
We can review the order and refund eligibility. Please provide the order details.
The product is not working.
Sorry about that. Please share the product and the issue you are seeing so we can investigate.
My package tracking has not updated.
We can check the shipment status. Please share the order or tracking details.
My account was hacked!
For account security concerns, please contact support through the secure account channel.
I need to cancel my order.
We can help review cancellation options. Please provide the order details.
Why was I charged a fee?
Please share the transaction details so the billing team can review the charge.
The delivery says delivered but I don't have it.
We can investigate a missing delivery. Please provide the order details.
I forgot my password.
Please use the password recovery process to regain access to your account.
I want to return my purchase.
We can help with the return process. Please provide the order details.
